title: Road Ahead bubble fixes
changes: Fixed the Road Ahead bubble not hiding when you left the Journey screen — a CSS specificity bug meant the hidden attribute was being overridden by the bubble's own display:flex rule.

Fixed an off-by-one in the bubble's "in N lessons" count — it was mixing a 1-indexed lesson number with a 0-indexed current-lesson index, so a lesson 1 away was shown as "in 2 lessons." The event was always on the correct lesson in the journey-ahead timeline; only the bubble's count was wrong.
